subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report + intake clarifications
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <security@altarhealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for SOC 2 Type II report and initial evidence

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this — Altar Health is starting our vendor security intake for the coming audit window and we need: 1) a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering the controls for the last 12 months (or bridge letter if the report window doesn’t match), and 2) an inventory of evidence you can provide (control snapshots, log retention samples, policy excerpts).

To help us triage, could you confirm:
- the audit window (start/end dates) covered by the Type II report you plan to share,
- whether you can provide a signed bridge letter covering gap dates (if any), and
- preferred secure transfer methods (S3 presigned, SharePoint, SFTP).

We typically need a receipt/manifest with filenames and short descriptions up front so our GRC team can schedule review. Target completion for our intake is Aug 12 — is that feasible?

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Head of Vendor Security | Altar Health
security@altarhealth.com

--
Attachment: intake_template.csv (placeholder)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <security@altarhealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for SOC 2 Type II report and initial evidence

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can support Altar Health on this intake. Quick summary and options below.

What we will provide this week:
- SOC 2 Type II report (period: 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30). If you need a different window, we can provide a bridge letter to cover the delta.
- Evidence manifest (attached): list of artifacts we can share now (policy excerpts, sample log exports, retention config screenshots).
- Bridge letter template (attached) — we can issue a signed bridge letter that references the Type II period and the specific controls covered.

Secure transfer options (pick one):
- S3 presigned links (preferred for bulk artifacts) — we will provide time-limited objects and a manifest.
- SharePoint/OneDrive secure folder (works for legal redactions).
- SFTP to a temporary intake account (we can coordinate credentials with your procurement team).

Quick ask for you:
- Confirm which transfer method you prefer.
- Confirm if your GRC team requires auditor contact details (we generally share auditor name and letter of reliance on request).
- If you need us to redact anything (customer names, internal IP addresses), please flag at submission; our legal team will coordinate.

Below are two very short reply templates you can drop into your ticket system or forward to stakeholders. Use whichever matches your flow:

1) "We confirm receipt and will provide the SOC 2 Type II (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30) and an evidence manifest via S3 presigned links by Aug 6. Please advise if you need a bridge letter for any gap dates."

2) "We prefer SharePoint for items requiring redaction. Please send SharePoint folder access to intake@altarhealth.com and we will upload by EOD Aug 6."

If Aug 12 is your target for review completion, our timeline is tight but achievable if transfer occurs by Aug 6.

Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

--
Attachments: redwood_typeii_manifest_v1.xlsx (manifest stub), bridge_letter_template.docx (template stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for SOC 2 Type II report and initial evidence

Markus / Dev — thanks for taking point. A couple of quick internal notes:
- Proceed with S3 presigned by default but flag items for redaction before upload (legal will handle).
- Please do not include any customer PII in the shared artifacts; if an evidence item contains customer data we should supply a sanitized export or screenshot.
- Confirm whether Altar requires auditor contact now or after they accept the bridge letter.

One-liner you can paste back to Alex: "We will provide the Type II report (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30), an evidence manifest, and S3 presigned links by Aug 6. Legal will coordinate any required redactions."

Grace
VP, Customer Trust | Redwood Inference

Thanks Markus and Grace — that works. We prefer S3 presigned links. Two quick clarifications before you upload:
- Can you confirm the retention window for the logs included in the manifest (we typically ask for 90-day sample exports and a 12-month retention policy snapshot)?
- For the bridge letter, please include the auditor name and the report issue date so our reviewers can map the controls.

If you can get the presigned links over by EOD Aug 6 we will queue review and aim to complete the intake by Aug 12. If anything changes we will escalate to procurement.

Best,
Alex
Head of Vendor Security | Altar Health
